Japanese/Chinese literati painting sensitivity, elegant asymmetrical panoramic composition, beautiful dry-brush granulation and wet-in-wet mineral grey textures, physical handmade paper, no photorealism, no digitally smooth concept-art mist, no watercolor rainbow, no dramatic fantasy architecture. records.title: 凌晨便利店

A solitary mint-blue vending machine stands beside it near the right side, abstract coloured rectangular products but no lettering. Dark navy apartment blocks and a few staggered lit windows recede on the left. Overhead wires are simple crisp stepped pixel paths. A tiny potted plant next to the shop door and an empty bench convey human life; no person needed. Rainy road fills the lower 30 percent in a large clean continuous area with segmented amber and muted teal puddle reflections. The sky upper-left is flat deep midnight indigo with sparse vertical integer-pixel rain dashes. The crucial visual style is authentic hand-placed retro pixel art, composed on approximately a 480x270 logical canvas and enlarged with nearest-neighbor-like sharp hard square blocks: visible consistent square pixel grid scale, precise stairstep diagonals, compact controlled colour clusters, only 24 colours, no antialiasing, NO blur, no soft brush strokes, no vector outlines, no photographic or painterly effects, no smooth lighting gradients. Every window edge and raindrop is pixel-crisp. Warm/cold lighting expressed through stacked discrete flat colour bands. Rich atmospheric artistry with restrained detail and large calm surfaces, like a masterful indie-game background. Keep rooflines fixed and scene legible, transparent empty rain corridors and open puddles for future pixel-based rain animation. Entirely original streetscape and building design.

records.title: 浮岛邮局
records.prompt: Generate one original premium landscape 16:9 desktop wallpaper, maximum native resolution, full bleed artwork with no text, logo, signature, border, UI, collage or labels. Title concept Floating Island Post Office. A real stylized LOW-POLYGON 3D RENDER, unmistakably a carefully modeled three-dimensional scene rendered in Blender/Cinema4D, flat-shaded triangular mesh surfaces, hard angular polygon edges, physically believable soft area lighting, ambient occlusion at contacts. NOT a painted concept illustration, NOT watercolor, NOT photoreal landscape, NOT smooth rounded clay. Broad nearly empty pale mint atmosphere surrounds exactly THREE suspended inverted-pyramid rock islands arranged on an elegant rising diagonal from lower-left to upper-right. Main island at x .57 y .57 is medium-sized and sculptural, its jagged underside composed of 15–25 large exposed ochre, terracotta, sand and mauve triangular rock facets. Flat moss-green polygonal turf on top, a tiny ivory-and-sienna post-office cottage with a sloped red geometric roof and a distinctly faceted simple small windmill behind it; two mint conical low-poly trees. A smaller island at x .29 y .64 bears a single cluster of faceted jade trees, and a smaller one at x .80 y .37 has three irregular low-poly rocks and a tiny cream geometric tower. Two extremely slender suspended wooden bridges connect the islands with clear readable support geometry, no impossible tangled cables. Each island is distinct with clean sky around its outline, occupies less than 23 percent of frame width. Flat polygonal milky-white clouds made of angular geometric forms sit much farther behind and near the bottom edges, sparse and widely separated. The rest is large clean pale turquoise negative space with subtle atmospheric depth. Use tasteful restrained mint, warm ivory, oxidized terracotta and sage; sunlight upper left gives alternating light and shade to every planar triangular facet. The islands must have strongly visible actual hard flat-shaded 3D polygon faces, like a premium low-poly game diorama. Calm high design, balanced scale, broad empty sky at upper-left for future ambient cloud particles. No characters, rabbits, carrots, flying vehicles, typography or image noise. Original scene independent of popular floating low-poly subjects.
